label: Every bearer of an occurring thought episode is CONCRETE_6 under the supplied world-independent…
paraphrase: Every bearer of an occurring thought episode is concrete under the supplied world-independent concreteness predicate. Neither occurrence nor bearing alone makes a bearer concrete. In the adopted esse-profile specialization, the predicate is HasEsseInRe and the bridge follows conditionally from bearer existence plus ExistingInActAt; the generic arbitrary-predicate interface is not thereby asserted for every legacy model.
